findings.ac: Logic Layer: add the v4.3.0 hash to the scaffold pristine map
findings.text: scaffold.py adds 8507cbfb... to KNOWN_SHIPPED_SCRIPT_HASHES['.agents/scripts/reconcile.py'], but no test or check in the slice asserts it equals the sha256 of the released v4.3.0 reconcile.py. It is also not the hash of the post-change reconcile.py (6d115aab...), so a wrong value would only show up as consumer update conflicts.
